desc: Build exhaustive state graphs for small parameters and test candidate residue/count invariants against connected components.
Derive algebraic invariants preserved by both operations, starting from counts and labeled particle positions.
Prove sufficiency of the identified reachability characterization, including legality of required move sequences.
Investigate special cases such as X+Y>N, insufficient zeros/ones, and X=Y.
Convert the characterization into an O(N) algorithm suitable for Python.
Produce a Python stdin/stdout implementation and validate it against the provided examples.
